title: Independently verify the first asynchronous helper hub on 791 inputs
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This independently verifies **the first asynchronous helper split of PR #5786**, rather than claiming its construction or conditional exponent. It binds the actual temporal contacts to the exact PR #5774 word, emits the first split in an independent label namespace, and checks every arbitrary-input endpoint and frame/owned-lifetime condition.

The result is `c=e696^T`, `d=e696+e697+e699+e709+e733+2e133`, with unit pairing. The literal witness checks **791 formal input axes, 625,681 endpoint positions, 25 owned lifetimes and peak 12 live owned fields**. The difference buffer is explicitly `z-x_h` before its charged CLEAR. The original 789-axis source endpoint is checked separately on all 622,521 positions.

The owned contact at time2=27501 subdivides query13750, `MOVE770:591->597`, through frame1031. Actual dimensions are **8 > 5 > 1**, hence paid ranks `7 -> (3,4)` and access-query delta **H3+H4-H7**. This is only the access query, not a full invoice. Helper target ranks are 5 and 4. Native maps/absolute phases, complete scalar/buffer/route pricing, later steps, physical caller, compiler and full admission remain open. The five framework assumptions are retained; no new kappa or frontier change is claimed.

## Task and overlap

Main: `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`, priority 8, refreshed before submission at 20:42 UTC. Exact predecessors: #5786 `6b936acd68a7e0f9062037900f0fe9bc4b6fdd25`; #5774 `7d6ec0cdef31d0c37b7d2563e709979caa0d5eae`.

This answers the released [first-step review request](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5600#discussioncomment-19202381). [Our claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5600#discussioncomment-19203981) changes the `formal-interface-lemma` card to this finite exact temporal-interface audit; **no Lean formalization or framework-assumption closure is claimed**. It differs from the active different-output-owner construction and the author's full replay. The final open-PR refresh covered 352 records; Discussion coverage is partial and unpublished work remains unknown.

The diff is exactly one 12-file package, `research/p104-async-first-hub-audit`. It vendors only the frozen word/plan data and retained NOTICE; neither checker imports predecessor implementations or the other checker. Source origin commits, paths, raw SHA256/Git blob identities and canonical word SHA256 are recorded. Self-contained data avoids reliance on cached unmerged commits.

## Validation

Python 3.12.14, standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-async-first-hub-audit
```

Registered normal/optimized primary and opposite-direction oracle pass. The oracle reconstructs collection by reverse covector and delivery by four independent forward perturbations, then checks source columns/pivot row for basis commutation. All typed receipts agree, with canonical JSON comparison preserving boolean/number distinctions.

Seven internal controls reject omitted collection, owned injection, causal order, wrong source binding, unpaid access, new buffer CLEAR and a swap sign; the last two fail at endpoint identities. Separate source/receipt corruption and boolean-number alias controls also reject; replacing canonical comparison with ordinary Python equality admits those aliases. These deliberately injected faults are controls, not defects alleged in predecessor code.

Metadata/pins, committed bytes/modes, declared current-main history and official export integrity pass. A separate read-only, Git-free `-I -O -W error -B` replay with empty PATH passes both checkers in about 1.42 seconds, with every exported byte/mode unchanged. Official export SHA256: `e582305b536fca3d18a6e4fd83acced78fa1b70dd34115ca8d5c90f2b02e7ddd`. The declared history check covers the main-context pin; original data origins are authenticated by retained bytes, not claimed as publication ancestors.

Current selected baseline passes **bindings/metadata only** after exact input materialization. No selected native replay ran. Hosted checks have not yet been observed; existing main's shared assignment-test failure is addressed separately by #5761. No hosted scientific pass is claimed.

Publication head: `c28110134390499b181ad62f5047514da4f3d5d1`; tree `0911eb0070abfa7ff8213d3aec535b1e417cf027`. This is an independent-label witness, not byte identity with the author's emitted word.

## Credit

Ali Romman, with OpenAI Codex assistance, supplied the asynchronous mechanism, plan and retained-copy source. Retain flyingviper's boundary bases, Joel Pulikkan/GamingPuzzled's basis work and every native/controller/compiler/BIT predecessor in NOTICE. New audit/proof: ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, using separate implementation, independent-oracle and read-only review contexts. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

Check native maps and absolute phases for the owned subdivision, then bind all boundary/buffer/scalar/route costs to the first-step full invoice. Steps 2/3 must use their own exact input words and event indices. [TASK.json](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c28110134390499b181ad62f5047514da4f3d5d1/research/p104-async-first-hub-audit/TASK.json) records the structured follow-up. No merge or closure is requested. Maintainer edits disabled.
